extra_status_paths=('server/src/main/resources/db/migration',)) records = migration_inventory(root) if not manifest.is_file() or manifest.is_symlink(): raise valueerror('flyway manifest must be a verify(root: pathlib.path, manifest: pathlib.path) -> tuple[int, int, str]: records, head, mapping = _verified_inventory(root, manifest) return len(records), head, mapping if __name__ == '__main__': row))) elif len(sys.argv) == 3: print('|'.join(map(str, verify(pathlib.path(sys.argv[1]), pathlib.path(sys.argv[2]))))) else: raise valueerror('expected repository and manifest, or one fixed read-only history sql selector') except (oserror, valueerror, subprocess.subprocesserror) as error: print(f'candidate rejected: {error}', file=sys.stderr) sys.exit(66)" to contain: ""warehouse_crosswalk.csv""
